thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated 5xx + streaming disconnects detected across gateway region eu-west-1 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call: @anya — severity: P2. Symptoms: 5xx rate spike ~ 12% -> 28% over last 6m, streaming clients showing chunked EOFs and sudden client cancels.
anya: I got the page, oncall here. quick summary pls, what endpoints affected?
ravi: Most traffic is to /v1/stream and /v1/paged/generate. Gateway logs show repeated 502 / 504, and streaming connections closing with "unexpected EOF" and partial chunk frames.
sam: I'm seeing increased gateway CPU and a backlog in the chunk encoder queue on gateways gtw-eu-03 / gtw-eu-04. Latency SLO breaches for token streaming for customers A, B.
devin: Correlating with deployment at 1778009000? There was a small config push to change keepalive and gateway chunk-size limits.
anya: Rollbackable? Can we flip the config or pin to stable?
alex: We can flip the feature flag for chunked framing back to legacy framing within 30s. Doing a canary on gtw-eu-03 first.
jessica: Customer impact: internal alert shows ~3% of active sessions disconnecting mid-stream, some clients show immediate retry which amplifies load. Top customers: AcmeAnalytics, NoteFlow.
anya: Ok prioritize rollback. alex — proceed canary, call it out when started. ravi — gather gateway logs and earliest error samples. sam — watch CPU and backlog. devin — keep an eye on recent config change.
alex: Canary started on gtw-eu-03 now.
incident-bot: Canary update: gtw-eu-03 traffic -> 5xx down from 27% to 9% in 2m.
anya: Nice. Start rolling to gtw-eu-04 and gtw-eu-02 but in small batches.
sam: Rolling to gtw-eu-04 now — monitoring CPU and queue length.
ravi: Sample of error pattern from /v1/stream logs:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:33Z] conn_id=abcd123 frame=chunked size=512 error=io: unexpected EOF
[2026-03-15T10:12:33Z] upstream=lm-serv-12 resp_code=502 message="write: broken pipe"
```
Seems like partial chunk/encoder error then upstream fails.
devin: I pulled the config diff: keepalive reduced to 20s and chunked_frame_max reduced from 64k->16k. That could increase fragmentation and cause timing races for some clients.
jessica: Customers seeing errors correlate with long-sequence prompts (avg seq_len > 1200 tokens) — more susceptible to fragmentation.
anya: Hypothesis: new framing causes more frequent flushes, upstream kernel or our streaming stack can't handle the higher rate of small frames -> client cancels + upstream 5xx. Rollback confirmed by config flag, rolling across remaining gateways.
alex: Rollout to gtw-eu-02 and gtw-eu-01 in progress (throttle 10% every 30s).
incident-bot: Rollback progress: 50% gateways updated, overall 5xx down to 11% and streaming disconnects drop by ~60%.
ravi: I'm attaching a clipped trace of a failed stream (error propagation path): chunk-encoder -> write timeout -> upstream retry -> connection reset.
sam: Observed immediate memory drop on gtw-eu-04 after rollback, backlog cleared.
devin: Will open a follow-up to adjust chunking defaults and add better backpressure metrics. For immediate mitigation maybe tune connection keepalive and increase chunk_frame_max for large sequences.
anya: Good. Next steps for live mitigation: 1) Keep rollback until config revert is posted to stable; 2) Add temporary autoscale bump for gateway pool in eu-west-1 (scale policy +20%) to reduce retry amplification; 3) Notify top impacted customers and CRO for potential SLA credit.
jessica: I'll draft customer-facing note and send to PMs for approval, pinging AcmeAnalytics and NoteFlow with ETA ~45m.
alex: Autoscale request submitted, nodes provisioning now.
incident-bot: Autoscale event: pool eu-west-1 gateways increased by 22% capacity at 10:20Z.
ravi: Captured a client cancel header example — clients send `x-client-cancel: user_abort` right after partial chunk at ~100ms. Suggest instrumenting a histogram of chunk_write_latency to detect when chunking stalls.
sam: Added a quick grafana panel for chunk_write_latency and partial_chunk_rate. Sharing link: https://grafana.redwood/in/dash/streaming-chunking (public to eng team).
anya: Good. For postmortem: capture the config diff, rollout timeline, impact table by customer, and mitigation timeline (canary -> rollback -> autoscale). Assign owners: devin config root cause, alex rollback automation, ravi logs/forensics, jessica customer comms.
devin: I'll revert the config in git and add a flag gate with better telemetry. Also adding unit test for small-frame stress.
jessica: Sent customer notes draft to PMs, will post when approved.
anya: Oncall stand-down in 30m unless new spikes appear. Keep watching for residual 5xx and client cancels.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to P3.
anya: Thanks team. Postmortem timeline and blameless RCA please. If anyone observed any other anomalies (e.g., TLS resets), drop logs here.
ravi: Found two TLSerrors in the same window but seems unrelated — filing a separate ticket.
sam: CPU back to normal, chunk backlog cleared. closing my watch channel.
devin: Reverting config PR now, will include the rollout safety gates.
anya: Great. I'll update ops IRC and mark the incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
